ground_residual_transfer.setup: Let (A,alpha) be one unital C*-system with closed generator delta, let hbar>0, and let D be a unital star-subalgebra that is a graph core for delta. Fix one sign sigma in {-1,+1}. For each n let pi_n be a unital representation, put A_n=pi_n(A), and let Omega_n be a normalized ground vector of the self-adjoint H_n(sigma h_n)=H_n(0)-sigma h_n S_n with ground energy E_n, where H_n(0), H_n(sigma h_n), and S_n are self-adjoint operators or forms under the declared pairings. Every A in D is required to lie in the represented commutator and vector/form domains used below. The theorem is applied separately to the two signs.
ground_residual_transfer.finite_energy_identity: Let hat omega_n(T)=<Omega_n,T Omega_n> on the declared represented pairings and tilde omega_n=hat omega_n o pi_n on A. With delta_n^0(A_n)=(i/hbar)[H_n(0),A_n], assume the quadratic-form commutator identity cal E_n(A)=q_(H_n(sigma h_n)-E_n)[A_n Omega_n]=-i hbar hat omega_n(A_n^* delta_n^0(A_n))-sigma h_n hat omega_n(A_n^*[S_n,A_n])>=0.
ground_residual_transfer.target_decomposition: Define d_n(A)=delta_n^0(A_n)-pi_n(delta A), in the declared form/vector sense, and R_n(A)=sigma h_n hat omega_n(A_n^*[S_n,A_n])+i hbar hat omega_n(A_n^*d_n(A)). Then -i hbar tilde omega_n(A^*delta A)=cal E_n(A)+R_n(A).
ground_residual_transfer.hypothesis: Assume the pullback states tilde omega_n converge weak-star to omega on A and the complex combined scalar residual satisfies |R_n(A)|->0 for every A in D.
ground_residual_transfer.conclusion: Weak-star passage gives -i hbar omega(A^*delta A)>=0 on D. Positivity for 1+zA for every complex z forces omega(delta A)=0. Graph-core closure extends both statements to Dom(delta), so omega is alpha-invariant and is an algebraic alpha-ground state.
ground_residual_transfer.sufficient_corollary: A stronger sufficient premise is that d_n(A) is bounded with ||d_n(A)||->0 and sigma h_n hat omega_n(A_n^*[S_n,A_n])->0 separately for every A in D. The theorem itself needs only the combined expectation-level residual.
ground_residual_transfer.scope: This is a conditional abstract target-carrier theorem. It constructs neither the exact-Q3 common target carrier nor its represented domain/core identifications, and it does not prove the Q3 combined residual estimate.

clipped_order_separation.setup: Let the two candidate states have locally normal extensions omega_+ and omega_- to one local von Neumann algebra M_X, related by a normal parity automorphism gamma. Let Q be a self-adjoint operator affiliated with M_X, gamma(Q)=-Q, omega_+(Q)>=m>0 and omega_+(|Q|^4)<=M_4.
clipped_order_separation.clip: For R>0 put B_R=clip(Q/R,-1,1). Functional calculus gives ||B_R||<=1, gamma(B_R)=-B_R and omega_+(B_R)>=d_R:=m/R-M_4/R^4. Choose R with d_R>0.
clipped_order_separation.carrier: Assume a parity-stable unital C*-carrier B inside M_X has strong-star dense unit ball. Normality, Kaplansky density and parity/self-adjoint symmetrization give, for any 0<epsilon<d_R, one fixed odd self-adjoint contraction b in B with |omega_+(b)-omega_+(B_R)|<epsilon.
clipped_order_separation.conclusion: The same fixed b obeys omega_+(b)>=d_R-epsilon, omega_-(b)<=-(d_R-epsilon), and ||omega_+|_B-omega_-|_B||>=2(d_R-epsilon). B_R itself is not claimed to belong to B.

inputs.omega_sigma: vector state of e_sigma, the Q-eigenvector with eigenvalue sigma

exact_m3_fixture.route_boundary: Here h_n->0 but h_n S_n=2Q does not vanish. The target K-generator is exact, the two weak-star limits are parity related and separated by the fixed bounded order Q, but the source scalar term does not vanish. The combined residual equals -2, the target energy form on A_sigma equals -1, and the limit state is not a K-ground state. Thus vanishing source is not a residual estimate. This growing-selector fixture is not Q3LOCK.
